source_text: Reges austro subiguntur Iesu duce — Adonisedec et socii. Omnis terra meridiana in sortem venit. Figura: vitia austri ardoris — ira libido — sub Christo prosternuntur.
pass_a_gloss: Kings in-south are-subdued with-Jesus leading — Adoni-zedek and allies. All land southern into lot comes. Figure: vices of-south of-heat — anger lust — under Christ are-laid-low.
pass_b_english: Southern kings fall under Jesus’ lead — Adoni-zedek and his allies. The whole south enters the lot. Figure: southern passions — anger and lust — are laid low under Christ.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
